#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <utility>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;

const int N = 50;
const int INF = INT_MAX;
const int MAXN = 50 * 3 + 1;

int n, m, k, c, d, mxt;
int s, t, fn;
vector<int> e[MAXN], to, fw, co;
int dep[MAXN], pre[MAXN];
bool vis[MAXN];

void addEdge(int u, int v, int w, int c) {
    e[u].push_back(sz(to));
    to.push_back(v);
    fw.push_back(w);
    co.push_back(c);
    e[v].push_back(sz(to));
    to.push_back(u);
    fw.push_back(0);
    co.push_back(-c);
}

bool spfa() {
    fill(dep, dep + fn, INF);
    fill(pre, pre + fn, -1);
    fill(vis, vis + fn, false);
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(s);
    vis[s] = true;
    dep[s] = 0;
    while (sz(q)) {
        int u = q.front();
        q.pop();
        vis[u] = false;
        for (int v : e[u]) {
            if (fw[v] && dep[to[v]] > dep[u] + co[v]) {
                dep[to[v]] = dep[u] + co[v];
                pre[to[v]] = v;
                (!vis[to[v]]) && (q.push(to[v]), vis[to[v]] = true);
            }
        }
    }
    return dep[t] < INF;
}

pii mcmf() {
    pii res(0, 0);
    while (spfa()) {
        int f = INF;
        for (int u = t; u != s; u = to[pre[u] ^ 1]) {
            f = min(f, fw[pre[u]]);
        }
        for (int u = t; u != s; u = to[pre[u] ^ 1]) {
            fw[pre[u]] -= f;
            fw[pre[u] ^ 1] += f;
        }
        res.x += f;
        res.y += dep[t] * f;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(0);
    cin.tie(0);
    cout.tie(0);
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    mxt = N * 3 + 1;
    fn = (t = (s = n * mxt) + 1) + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int u;
        cin >> u;
        --u;
        addEdge(s, u, 1, 0);
    }
    while (m--) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        --u;
        --v;
        for (int i = 0; i < mxt - 1; i++) {
            for (int p = 1; p <= k + 1; p++) {
                addEdge(i * n + u, (i + 1) * n + v, 1, 2 * d * p - d);
                addEdge(i * n + v, (i + 1) * n + u, 1, 2 * d * p - d);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
        for (int i = 0; i < mxt; i++) {
            addEdge(i * n + u, (i + 1) * n + u, k, 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < mxt; i++) {
        addEdge(i * n + t, t, k, i * c);
    }
    pii ans = mcmf();
    assert(ans.x == k);
    cout << ans.y << '\n';
    return 0;
}
